title: At Komorebi St.
love: one of my favorites from Lamp; soft, warm, and really easy to keep coming back to.
notes: Lamp's third album, released in 2005. Its title refers to komorebi: sunlight filtering through trees.

title: Lamp Phantasma
love: one of the best Lamp albums i have ever heard. this was the album that made me fall in love with Lamp. been a fan ever since.
notes: Lamp's fourth full-length album, released in 2008. The title plays on illusion, fantasy, dreams, and ghosts.

title: Afterglow
love: shorter and quieter. this EP was sooooooo good!
notes: A 2007 compilation EP with six tracks, including 4 AM from Lamp's early demo recordings.

title: Soyokaze Apartment Room 201
alternateTitle: そよ風アパートメント201
love: super different than the other albums i have heard from them. in my top 5 albums from the band!
notes: Lamp's first album, released in 2003. Soyokaze means breeze, chosen to match the easy-going mood.

title: YOTSUBA&♪
love: super charming and cozy, the kind of CD that feels nice to own physically. i love Yotsuba!
notes: Image album for Kiyohiko Azuma's Yotsuba&!, released April 2, 2005 by Geneon and Rondo Robe.
